lines.en: Three steps for each swing of the censer.
My hem sweeps over dried wax.
One turn around the altar, never on the line.

lines.zh: 我赤脚走，石砖要认得我。
lines.en: Barefoot, so the tiles know me.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在旧脚印上。
lines.en: Each step lands in an older footprint.
I must reach my place before the bell.
Ash falls on my shoulder; I leave it.
Three lines must be spoken at the hall's end.
I walk slowly so the words stay ordered.
The hand that holds the lamp must not shake.
Step over the threshold, never on it.
Ash marks my footprints.
The candle is a finger shorter; time to change it.

lines.zh: 今夜的祷词，我念到第七段。
lines.en: Tonight I reached the seventh verse.
The incense is gone; the scent remains.
I wait for the bell; the bell waits for me.

lines.zh: 坛上的纹路，又深了一点。
lines.en: The altar's grooves have deepened again.
Who set the vessels backward?

lines.zh: 我的嗓子哑了，词还没念完。
lines.en: My voice is raw; the verses are not done.
A flower on the wick is a good omen.

lines.zh: 我数着念珠，念珠数着我。
lines.en: I count the beads; the beads count me.
There is an echo beneath the sanctum floor.

lines.zh: 你身上没有熏香的味道。
lines.en: You carry no incense.

lines.zh: 站到灯下，让我看你的手。
lines.en: Step into the light; show me your hands.
Your shadow falls across the altar.

lines.zh: 你眼里有火，不是圣所的火。
lines.en: Your eyes hold a fire not of this place.

lines.zh: 我在你额上看到一个记号。
lines.en: I see a mark on your brow.

lines.zh: 你看坛的样子，像在看门。
lines.en: You look at the altar like a door.

lines.zh: 别低头，祷词要看着人说。
lines.en: Do not bow; verses are spoken face to face.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了仪式的拍子。
lines.en: Your breathing breaks the ritual's rhythm.

lines.zh: 你袖子里藏着什么？灰吗？
lines.en: What hides in your sleeve? Ash?

lines.zh: 我认得这双眼睛，见过太多次。
lines.en: I know those eyes; I have seen them often.

lines.zh: 别打我的手，我还要念词。
lines.en: Not my hands; I still have verses.
That shook the ash loose.

lines.zh: 我退到坛边，靠着它站稳。
lines.en: I back to the altar and steady myself on it.
A bone cracked; the verse did not break.
You interrupted the third verse.
The wound can wait; the rhythm cannot.

lines.zh: 我袍子厚，里面全是香灰。
lines.en: My robe is thick and full of ash.

lines.zh: 这一击，我记在祷词末尾。
lines.en: I add that blow to the closing prayer.
The lamp still burns, so I am fine.
Once more and I change the wording.

lines.zh: 供品要放在坛上，不是手里。
lines.en: Offerings go on the altar, not in your hand.

lines.zh: 绿宝石？坛上只收香和盐。
lines.en: Emeralds? The altar takes incense and salt.
Hold it up and the rite breaks.
I touch no coin; my hands must stay clean.

lines.zh: 这块布不错，可以盖祭器。
lines.en: Good cloth; it could cover the vessels.
Food is offered first, then shared.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高点，比给我东西有用。
lines.en: Raise the lamp; that helps more than gifts.

lines.zh: 收下它，我就得重念一遍。
lines.en: Accepting it means repeating the rite.
Temptation is also a kind of offering.
Set it down before your shadow covers it.
Not the censer; the ash will spill.
Move your boot; the line is under it.
Back away; one step from the altar is barred.
That bumped the flame crooked.
My joints are brittle; do not shove.

lines.zh: 你碰倒了盐，仪式要重来。
lines.en: You spilled the salt; the rite restarts.
Steady; do not scuff the chalk line.
The incense nearly slipped from my hand.
Look down before you bump me.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记在祷词后面。
lines.en: That goes after the closing verse.

lines.zh: 祭司不结伴，只结缘于坛。
lines.en: Ritualists take no partner, only the altar.
My vows are spoken to the sanctum.
Two voices on one verse would tangle.

lines.zh: 香火传不下去，名册可以。
lines.en: Incense lines end; the ledger continues.
I never kept a place for anyone.
Fellow acolytes, yes; a shared bed, no.
The altar has no wedding lines.

lines.zh: 我的手指只用来数念珠。
lines.en: My fingers are only for counting beads.
The sanctum's children come through the door.
This robe is worn by one.
What falls before the altar gets offered first.
This ring — where is its owner?
I pick it up and blow off the ash.
Bend slowly; the lamp must stay steady.

lines.zh: 碎片收好，坛上不能有杂。
lines.en: Gather the shards; the altar must stay clean.

lines.zh: 这不是祭器，放错地方了。
lines.en: This is no vessel; it is misplaced.
My fingers are thin; I can hold it.
Lost things go to the bell room.
This bone came from somewhere wrong.
Picking things up is a kind of cleaning.

lines.zh: 钟还没响，你不该在这里。
lines.en: The bell has not rung; you should not be here.
Fresh prints in the ash.
Someone touched the altar's grooves.
I heard a verse break off.
A stranger at the altar changes the rite.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，不在拍子上。
lines.en: Your steps are off the beat.
The flame leans toward you; there is a draft.
The salt line at the door is broken.

lines.zh: 你手里的火，不是灯里的。
lines.en: That fire in your hand is not the lamp's.

lines.zh: 圣所的记录里，今晚没有客。
lines.en: The sanctum's record lists no guest tonight.

lines.zh: 我看见你从侧廊进来了。
lines.en: I saw you come in from the side hall.
Did you open the bell room?

lines.zh: 祭器少了一件，你身上有铁味。
lines.en: A vessel is missing; you smell of iron.
Stand outside the circle; spare the chalk.
The altar flame leans toward you.
I finish this verse before I move.
Outside the circle, and I will not follow.
I raise my hand; the lamp leans toward you.
When the bell rings, the doors close.

lines.zh: 别碰那根绳，它能叫醒圣所。
lines.en: Do not touch that rope; it wakes the sanctum.
I count to seven, and the rite completes.
The chalk under your feet is a boundary.

lines.zh: 我在你身后念，你听不见的。
lines.en: I chant behind you; you will not hear it.

lines.zh: 香在烧，时间不站在你那边。
lines.en: The incense burns; time is not on your side.
The more you rush, the more precise my words.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯，我一路点过去了。
lines.en: I lit the corridor lamps as I came.

lines.zh: 你踩灭了蜡烛，就得留下。
lines.en: You snuffed a candle; now you must stay.
I need not chase; the doors obey me.

lines.zh: 退路在香灰里，早被扫了。
lines.en: Your retreat was swept away with the ash.
I set the incense first; then it is your turn.

lines.zh: 门槛上的盐，你跨过来了。
lines.en: You stepped over the salt on the threshold.

lines.zh: 我念得慢，是给你留时间。
lines.en: I chant slowly to give you time.

lines.zh: 灯一盏盏灭，路就一条条断。
lines.en: As the lamps go out, the ways close one by one.

lines.zh: 这一杖，替坛上缺的那件。
lines.en: This staff strikes for the missing vessel.

lines.zh: 我打人之前，会先念一句。
lines.en: I speak one line before I strike.
The censer is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 别抓我的袖子，那上面有火。
lines.en: Not my sleeve; it carries fire.
This one lands on your wrist.
No blade; a blade would stain the altar.
Retreat, and the verse can finish.
The candle fell; that is on you.
The staff is iron-tipped and accurate.

lines.zh: 打你不算仪式，只是清扫。
lines.en: Striking you is cleaning, not ritual.

lines.zh: 你跪下了，正合祷词的姿势。
lines.en: Kneeling suits the verse nicely.
That will stay with you until morning.

lines.zh: 我力气小，落点却挑得准。
lines.en: Little strength, but I pick the spot.
Touch the vessels and you pay for it.
My staff head knocks your collarbone.
I throw incense ash into your eyes.
The incense is lit; I must speak.
Two bells; the rite begins.
I take the lamp down from the altar.

lines.zh: 今夜的粉线，画得比昨天圆。
lines.en: Tonight's chalk circle is rounder than yesterday's.
The robe smells musty; the sanctum is damp.

lines.zh: 我数了七遍，才敢踏进来。
lines.en: I counted seven times before entering.
The altar fire lit itself.

lines.zh: 有人在我之前念过这段。
lines.en: Someone recited this before me.
I carry incense through three doors.

lines.zh: 名册上添一个名字，我来念。
lines.en: A name was added; I will read it.

lines.zh: 地板缝里，又长出新的纹。
lines.en: New lines have grown in the floor's cracks.

lines.zh: 我的影子在坛上，比别人长。
lines.en: My shadow on the altar is longer than most.
Fire meets incense and grows.
Wax on the steps; I should have wiped it.
Water in the altar — a bad omen.

lines.zh: 瓶罐全碎了，仪式要重备。
lines.en: Every vessel shattered; the rite must be remade.

lines.zh: 箭钉在坛上，拔出来有裂。
lines.en: The arrow stuck in the altar and left a crack.
Another chant is competing with mine.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃，香闻久了不饿。
lines.en: I forgot to eat; incense dulls hunger.
Lightning struck the bell tower; the bell still rings.
The void has no verses to speak.
